items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: we go in and are going to do a session... Rene said to me... I think it would be better if you use your man... we got set up and that night when we went to record Butchie didn't come

ctx.x: He was a nice musician, and so we played there and had Butch Luckett--
You had some great guys in your band.
